prompts.factory: Edit image 1 into a production transparent character sprite for the Chinese Republican-era pawnshop game in image 2. Image 1 is the identity and framing reference, image 2 is ONLY the environment/painterly style and lighting reference. Preserve the SAME middle-aged Chinese factory owner Li Heng: angular slightly asymmetrical face, swept salt-and-pepper hair, subtle mustache, tired serious brows, charcoal three-piece suit, ivory shirt, patterned dark tie, watch chain, folded invoices in hand. Preserve his pose, proportions, top-of-head position and bottom waist crop, keep full elbows and hands. Redraw with unified hand-painted matte opaque gouache/oil concept-art brushwork matching the background: broader intentional value shapes, simplified skin and wool texture, no photographic pores, no waxy polygon skin, no digitally sharpened hair strands. Lower facial orange saturation and bright white highlights. Ambient gray-green cool light from alley above/back, very soft warm brown reflected light from wooden counter below, soft lost edges on outer sleeves and hair, readable face without studio spotlights or rim halo. Rich person with fine tailoring, not dirty or impoverished. Output one isolated half-body figure only, centered in square canvas, exact same composition as image1, genuine transparent alpha background including around hands, no magenta backdrop, no table, no environment, no lettering, no drop shadow. The goal is a character painted by the same artist as the environment, not a photographic cutout with a texture filter.
prompts.silk: Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer. Edit image 1 into a finished Republican-era game character sprite, image 2 is the actual pawnshop scene STYLE/LIGHT reference ONLY. Subject: Zhou Jinsheng, Chinese slim middle-aged silk merchant, narrow face, arched eyebrow, curled thin moustache, black round skullcap, muted burgundy brocade waistcoat over ivory silk robe, holding navy gold-patterned fabric in both hands. Preserve EXACT character identity, recognizable face, age, pose, clothing, accessories, relative head size and source square framing. Preserve full head and hands and elbows with waist reaching bottom as original. REPAINT materially: restrained hand-painted opaque gouache and oil illustration matching the scene's soft matte weathered wood and stone; broad confident organic brush strokes, grouped shadows, subtle natural skin tones. Remove repeated mosaic-like facets and tiny sharp yellow strokes, photographic pores and over-sharpened fabric detail. Clothing patterns should be suggested softly, not mechanically embossed. Slightly cooler muted gray-green shadows, modest soft warm reflected wooden-counter light from below, diffuse daylight above; reduce orange skin and chalk-white highlights. No orange studio key light or bright rim halo. Keep fine clothing and rich person's dignity. Face remains readable at 400px game height; naturally asymmetrical features. Lower edges and hair softer than face, not outlined cutout. Produce ONLY this one half-body character on genuine transparent alpha, no scene, no furniture, no colored background, no checkboard printed background, no captions. This must look painted by the environment artist, not a photo with an oil filter.
